Definition: from G1062; to wed (of either sex):--marry (a wife).
BiblicalUsage: Gameo means to marry, and the New Testament uses it for the bonds and the breaking of marriage. Paul commands the married not to depart in 1 Corinthians 7:10, and he warns of those forbidding to marry in 1 Timothy 4:3. A man says he has married a wife and cannot come to the supper in Luke 14:20, and Jesus says whoever puts away his wife and marries another commits adultery in Mark 10:11.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe marriage is a covenant God guards with His own words. Paul commands it, Jesus defines it, and the man who pleads his new wife as an excuse for missing the supper shows how easily even a good gift becomes a reason to stay away. I hold that marriage is honourable, and the wedding feast greater still.
